title: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
why: Disney's folly premiered on 21 December 1937 and invented the animated feature. Also the winter solstice — the longest night to be lost in a wood.

title: Eyes Wide Shut
why: Christmas week in New York, lit entirely by fairy lights, in the darkest days of the year.

title: At Eternity's Gate
why: Van Gogh cuts off his ear in Arles on 23 December 1888, after Gauguin walks out.

title: Die Hard
why: The Nakatomi Corporation Christmas party, Christmas Eve, Century City. Now I have a machine gun. Ho ho ho.
alternates: It's a Wonderful Life; The Muppet Christmas Carol; Eyes Wide Shut; Cast Away (the crash)

title: A Christmas Story
why: Christmas morning in Hohman, Indiana: the Red Ryder BB gun, the leg lamp, the Chinese turkey.

title: The Impossible
why: The Boxing Day tsunami hits Khao Lak just after 7:58am on 26 December 2004.
alternates: The Crossing — Washington crosses the Delaware on the night of 25/26 December 1776

title: Bhutto
why: Benazir Bhutto is killed leaving a rally in Rawalpindi on 27 December 2007.
alternates: The Beagle sails with Darwin aboard, 27 December 1831

title: Lumiere!
why: Cinema's own birthday: the Lumières' first paying public screening at the Salon Indien, 28 December 1895.

title: Bury My Heart at Wounded Knee
why: The Seventh Cavalry opens fire at Wounded Knee Creek on 29 December 1890.
alternates: Thomas Becket murdered in Canterbury Cathedral, 29 December 1170 — Becket (1964)

title: Rasputin: The Mad Monk
why: Yusupov's cellar, the poisoned cakes, the river: Rasputin is killed on the night of 29/30 December 1916.
alternates: Nicholas and Alexandra (1971); the USSR founded, 30 December 1922

title: When Harry Met Sally...
why: Harry runs across Manhattan to a New Year's Eve party to get there before midnight.
alternates: 200 Cigarettes; Boogie Nights (the 1979 party); The Poseidon Adventure; The Time Machine (31 December 1899); Trading Places
